title: ETs tell government leaders to develop spiritually

tellings.quote: alleged stories of ET visitation saying to our government leaders, you have to develop spiritually before we can exchange more technological information with you or or material with you.

plain: Aliens are said to have told government leaders that humanity must "develop spiritually" before they will share more technology or material with us. A guest named Dave Rossi, who says aliens taught him advanced physics, passes this on from stories he heard from the lawyer Dan Sheehan. If true, it would mean the holdup in contact is our own inner growth, not a lack of technology.
